Related insight: Related insight: Tutorial 11 (wasp_11) continues the Wasp advanced tutorial series beyond tutorial 10, introducing further aggregation techniques with a focus on multiple-part-types, connection-configurations, and advanced modular discrete-element assembly. Tutorial 10 is a direct prerequisite for tutorial 11, and the two share closely related content around multi-part advanced aggregation strategies.

Related insight: Related insight: Tutorial 12 (wasp_12) continues the Wasp advanced tutorial series beyond tutorial 11, extending the RuleGenerator series with further rule-grammar and generative-assembly techniques. Tutorial 10 is an indirect prerequisite for tutorial 12 via tutorial 11.

Related insight: Related insight: Tutorial 16 (wasp_16) continues the Wasp advanced tutorial series well beyond tutorial 12, confirming the series extends through at least tutorial 16. Tutorial 16 introduces isoline-based techniques and 3d-populate strategies as continuing advanced topics, alongside field-driven aggregation concepts. Tutorial 10 is an indirect prerequisite for tutorial 16 via the intermediate tutorials in the series.

Related insight: Related insight: Tutorial 17 (wasp_17) continues the Wasp advanced tutorial series beyond tutorial 16, confirming the series extends through at least tutorial 17. Tutorial 17 further develops field-driven aggregation with scalar-field biased-growth, parametric-growth, and custom-preview techniques. Tutorial 10 is an indirect prerequisite for tutorial 17 via the intermediate tutorials in the series.

Related insight: Related insight: Tutorial 18 (wasp_18) continues the Wasp advanced tutorial series beyond tutorial 17, confirming the series extends through at least tutorial 18. Tutorial 18 further develops field-driven aggregation with scalar-field biased-growth, parametric-growth, isoline, and attribute-based techniques. Tutorial 10 is an indirect prerequisite for tutorial 18 via the intermediate tutorials in the series.

Related insight: Related insight: Tutorial 19 (wasp_19) continues the Wasp advanced tutorial series beyond tutorial 18, confirming the series extends through at least tutorial 19. Tutorial 19 further develops field-driven aggregation with scalar-field biased-growth, voxel-based techniques, and parametric-assembly strategies. Tutorial 10 is an indirect prerequisite for tutorial 19 via the intermediate tutorials in the series.

curriculum.title: The Aggregation Graph component allows to visualize the graph of the generated a
curriculum.text:
The Aggregation Graph component allows to visualize the graph of the generated aggregation:
- the FG input allows to choose between full graph (including adjacent connections not directly defined)
or only the graph describing the rules sequence.
- the TOL input allows to override the default tolerance below which two elements are considered
connected
- when FG is set to True, setting FR to True filters "accidental" connections found against the given
aggregation rules.
- The CR input allows to specify a custom set of rules for filtering. If not specified, the component uses
the Aggregation rules.
- the F input allows to choose between flattened or tree-structured output
